data.name: Unbeatable Maze
data.detailed_description:
Think you’re good at mazes?

Good, because you’re going to need every bit of skill, focus, and stubborn determination you have.

Unbeatable Maze is a minimalist but brutally challenging puzzle experience built around one core idea: make the impossible feel within reach… until it isn’t. Guide your tiny dot through 60 carefully crafted labyrinths before the timer hits zero. Each maze is unique. Each maze is harder than the last. And each maze is absolutely unforgiving.

The game starts gently, letting you settle into its clean, modern visuals and simple controls. But don’t get comfortable. Every completed level unlocks something more twisted with deadlier turns, deceptive layouts, and labyrinths designed to break the habits of even the best puzzle solvers.

With five escalating difficulty modes: Easy, Medium, Hard, Nightmare, and Hell - Unbeatable Maze constantly pushes you toward sharper focus and tighter decision-making. Some levels offer branching routes and clever shortcuts. Others have only one perfect path, demanding absolute precision.

  • This is a puzzle game with no distractions.

  • No enemies to fight. No stats to upgrade.

  • Just you, the clock, and the maze.

If you enjoy brain-bending challenges, minimalist puzzle design, and that adrenaline rush when you finally escape a seemingly impossible labyrinth, you’re exactly where you need to be.

The question is simple:

Can you conquer all 60 mazes—or will you get lost forever?

  • 60 levels from easy to super hard

  • Career and free play mode

  • Easy to start, hard to finish :)

data.short_description: Face 60 handcrafted labyrinths in a minimalist, fast-paced maze challenge. Guide your dot to the exit before time runs out across five difficulty levels. No enemies, no tricks, just pure logic, precision, and impossible maze-solving.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Vietnamese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard required
